title: Slovakian Spicy Prawn Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful Slovakian-inspired dish, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. Marinate prawns in a spicy mixture and grill to perfection.

ingredients.name: tiger skewers
ingredients.notes: wooden or metal, depending on preference

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together Slovakian spicy marinade ingredients.
2. Add prawns to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Thread marinated prawns onto tiger skewers.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until prawns are pink and cooked through.
6. Serve immediately, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
